40022712.author: पदार्थः
40022712.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, लक्ष्मणेन by Lakshmana, उक्तं spoken, वाक्यं word, वाक्यविशारदः expert in speech, प्रत्युवाच replied, महातेजाः greatly effulgent, प्रहसन् smiling, राघवः Rama, वचः words.

40022712.author: Translation
40022712.content: Having heard the words spoken by Lakshmana, Rama, who was greatly effulgent and an expert in speech, replied with a smile.

40022713.author: पदार्थः
40022713.content: एवमेव exactly so, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, यथा as, वदसि you say, लक्ष्मण Lakshmana, वृत्रघातम् the slaying of Vritra, अशेषेण completely, वाजिमेधफलम् the fruit of Ashwamedha sacrifice, च and, यत् which.

40022713.author: Translation
40022713.content: Rama affirmed to Lakshmana, "O best among men, what you say is exactly true, regarding the complete slaying of Vritra and the fruit of the Ashwamedha sacrifice."

40022714.author: पदार्थः
40022714.content: श्रूयते it is heard, हि indeed, पुरा formerly, सौम्य O gentle one, कर्दमस्य of Kardama, प्रजापतेः the Prajapati, पुत्रः son, बाह्लीश्वरः lord of Bahlika, श्रीमान् glorious, इलः Ila, नाम named, महाशयाः of great mind.

40022714.author: Translation
40022714.content: O gentle one, it is indeed heard that formerly, there was a glorious son of Prajapati Kardama, named Ila, who was the lord of Bahlika and of great mind.

40022715.author: पदार्थः
40022715.content: सः that, राजा king, पृथिवीं earth, सर्वां entire, वशे under control, कृत्वा having made, सुधार्मिकः very righteous, राज्यं kingdom, च and, एव indeed, नरव्याघ्र O tiger among men, पुत्रवत् like a son, पर्यपालयत् protected.

40022715.author: Translation
40022715.content: That very righteous king, having brought the entire earth under his control, protected his kingdom as if it were his own son, O tiger among men.

40022716.author: पदार्थः
40022716.content: सुरैः by gods, च and, परमोदारैः extremely generous, दैतेयैः by Daityas, च and, महाधनैः very wealthy, नागराक्षसगन्धर्वैः by Nagas, Rakshasas, and Gandharvas, यक्षैः by Yakshas, च and, सुमहात्मभिः very noble-minded.

40022716.author: Translation
40022716.content: He was revered by extremely generous gods, very wealthy Daityas, Nagas, Rakshasas, Gandharvas, and very noble-minded Yakshas.

40022717.author: पदार्थः
40022717.content: पूज्यते is worshipped, नित्यशः constantly, सौम्य O gentle one, भयार्तैः by the fearful, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus, अबिभ्यंश्च and fearless, त्रयो लोकाः the three worlds, सरोषस्य of the wrathful, महात्मनः great soul.

40022717.author: Translation
40022717.content: O gentle Rama, O delight of the Raghus, this great and wrathful king is constantly worshipped by those afflicted with fear, and due to his power, the three worlds are fearless.

40022718.author: पदार्थः
40022718.content: सः that, राजा king, तादृशः such, हि indeed, आसीत् was, धर्मे in righteousness, वीर्ये in valor, च and, निष्ठितः established, बुद्ध्या in intellect, च and, परमोदारः supremely noble, बाह्लीकेशः the lord of Bahlika, महायशाः greatly renowned.

40022718.author: Translation
40022718.content: That king, the lord of Bahlika, was indeed such a one, firmly established in righteousness and valor, supremely noble in intellect, and greatly renowned.

40022719.author: पदार्थः
40022719.content: सः he, प्रचक्रे undertook, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, मृगयाम् hunting, रुचिरे in a beautiful, वने forest, चैत्रे in Chaitra, मनोरमे delightful, मासि month, सभृत्यबलवाहनः with servants, army, and conveyances.

40022719.author: Translation
40022719.content: The mighty-armed king undertook a hunt in a beautiful forest during the delightful month of Chaitra, accompanied by his servants, army, and conveyances.

40022720.author: पदार्थः
40022720.content: प्रजघ्ने killed, च and, नृपः the king, अरण्ये in the forest, मृगान् animals, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands, हत्वा having killed, एव even, तृप्तिः satisfaction, न not, अभूत् was, च and, राज्ञः of the king, तस्य that, महात्मनः great soul.

40022720.author: Translation
40022720.content: And the king killed hundreds of thousands of animals in the forest, yet even after killing so many, that great-souled king was not satisfied.

40022721.author: पदार्थः
40022721.content: नानामृगाणाम् of various animals, अयुतम् ten thousand, वध्यमानम् being killed, महात्मना by the great soul, यत्र where, जातः was born, माहासेनः Mahasena, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.

40022721.author: Translation
40022721.content: While ten thousand animals of various kinds were being killed by the great-souled king, he approached that region where Mahasena (Kartikeya) was born.

40022722.author: पदार्थः
40022722.content: तस्मिन्प्रदेशे in that region, देवेश the lord of gods, शैलराजसुतां the daughter of the king of mountains, हरः Hara, रमयामास made to sport, दुर्धर्षः the unassailable one, सर्वैः with all, अनुचरैः attendants, सह together.

40022722.author: Translation
40022722.content: In that region, the unassailable Hara, the lord of gods, sported with Parvati, the daughter of the king of mountains, accompanied by all his attendants.

40022723.author: पदार्थः
40022723.content: कृत्वा having made, स्त्रीरूपम् a female form, आत्मानम् himself, उमेशः the lord of Uma, गोपतिध्वजः one whose banner has a bull, देव्याः of the goddess, प्रियचिकीर्षुः desirous of doing what is pleasing, सन् being, तस्मिन् in that, पर्वतनिर्झरे mountain stream.

40022723.author: Translation
40022723.content: Desirous of pleasing the goddess, Shiva, the lord of Uma whose banner bears a bull, transformed himself into a female form in that mountain stream.

40022724.author: पदार्थः
40022724.content: ये those who, तु indeed, तत्र there, वनोद्देशे in the forest region, सत्त्वाः beings, पुरुषवादिनः called males, वृक्षाः trees, पुरुषनामानः named as males, ते they, अभवन् became, स्त्रीजनाः women, तदा then.

40022724.author: Translation
40022724.content: Then, all the male beings and trees with male names in that forest region transformed into women.

40022725.author: पदार्थः
40022725.content: यत् whatever, च and, किञ्चन anything, तत् that, सर्वम् all, नारीसञ्ज्ञं having a female form, बभूव became, ह indeed. एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, राजा king, सः that, इलः Ila, कर्दमात्मजः son of Kardama, निघ्नन् killing, मृगसहस्राणि thousands of deer, तम् that, देशम् region, उपचक्रमे approached.

40022725.author: Translation
40022725.content: Indeed, everything there became female, and in the meantime, King Ila, the son of Kardama, entered that region while hunting thousands of deer.

40022726.author: पदार्थः
40022726.content: सः he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, सर्वम् everything, सव्यालमृगपक्षकम् with wild animals, deer, and birds, आत्मानं himself, स्त्रीकृतं made into a female, च and, एव indeed, सानुगं with his followers, रघुनन्दन O delight of the Raghus.

40022726.author: Translation
40022726.content: O delight of the Raghus, upon seeing everything—including wild animals, deer, and birds—transformed into females, and himself along with his followers also turned into women, he was astonished.

40022727.author: पदार्थः
40022727.content: तस्य tasya, his, दुःखं duḥkhaṃ, sorrow, महत् mahat, great, च ca, and, आसीत् āsīt, was, दृष्ट्वा dṛṣṭvā, having seen, आत्मानं ātmānaṃ, himself, तथागतम् tathāgatam, in that state, उमापतेः umāpateḥ, of the lord of Uma (Shiva), च ca, and, तत् tat, that, कर्म karma, deed, ज्ञात्वा jñātvā, having known, त्रासम् trāsam, fear, उपागमत् upāgamat, he attained.

40022727.author: Translation
40022727.content: Seeing himself transformed and realizing that this was the deed of Lord Shiva, he was overcome with great sorrow and fear.

40022728.author: पदार्थः
40022728.content: ततः tataḥ, then, देवं devaṃ, to the god, महात्मानं mahātmānaṃ, the great-souled, शितिकण्ठं śitikaṇṭhaṃ, blue-necked, कपर्दिनम् kapardinam, one with matted hair, जगाम jagāma, went, शरणं śaraṇaṃ, for refuge, राजा rājā, the king, सभृत्यबलवाहनः sabhṛtyabalavāhanaḥ, with his servants, army, and vehicles.

40022728.author: Translation
40022728.content: Then, the king, along with his servants, army, and vehicles, went to seek refuge with the great-souled, blue-necked, matted-haired god (Shiva).

40022729.author: पदार्थः
40022729.content: ततः tataḥ, then, प्रहस्य prahasya, having laughed, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, सह saha, with, देव्या devyā, the goddess, महेश्वरः maheśvaraḥ, the great lord (Shiva), प्रजापतिसुतं prajāpatisutaṃ, to the son of Prajapati, वाक्यम् vākyam, words, उवाच uvāca, spoke, वरदः varadaḥ, the bestower of boons, स्वयम् svayam, himself.

40022729.author: Translation
40022729.content: Then, the great lord Maheśvara, the bestower of boons, laughed with the goddess and himself spoke these words to the son of Prajapati.

40022730.author: पदार्थः
40022730.content: उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, उत्तिष्ठ uttiṣṭha, arise, राजर्षे rājarṣe, O royal sage, कार्दमेय kārdameya, O son of Kardama, महाबल mahābala, O mighty one, पुरुषत्वम् puruṣatvam, manhood, ऋते ṛte, except for, सौम्य saumya, O gentle one, वरम् varam, a boon, वरय varaya, choose, सुव्रत suvrata, O one of good vows.

40022730.author: Translation
40022730.content: Lord Shiva commanded, "Arise, arise, O royal sage, O son of Kardama, O mighty one; O gentle one, O one of good vows, choose any boon except for manhood."

40022731.author: पदार्थः
40022731.content: ततः tataḥ, then, सः saḥ, that, राजा rājā, king, दुःखार्तः duḥkhārtaḥ, afflicted by sorrow, प्रत्याख्यातः pratyākhyātaḥ, rejected, महात्मना mahātmanā, by the great-souled one, न na, not, च ca, and, जग्राह jagrāha, accepted, स्त्रीभूतो strībhūto, having become a woman, वरम् varam, a boon, अन्यम् anyam, other, सुरोत्तमात् surottamāt, from the best of gods.

40022731.author: Translation
40022731.content: Then, that king, afflicted by sorrow and rejected by the great-souled one, did not accept any other boon from the best of gods, having become a woman.

40022732.author: पदार्थः
40022732.content: ततः then, शोकेन with sorrow, महता great, शैलराजसुतां to the daughter of the king of mountains, नृपः the king, प्रणिपत्य having bowed down, हि indeed, उमां Uma, देवीं to the goddess, सर्वेण with all, एव indeed, अन्तरात्मना with his inner self.

40022732.author: Translation
40022732.content: Then, overwhelmed by great sorrow, the king bowed down to the goddess Uma, the daughter of the king of mountains, with his entire heart and soul.

40022733.author: पदार्थः
40022733.content: ईशे You are the mistress, वराणां of boons, वरदे O giver of boons, लोकानाम् of the worlds, असि you are, भामिनी O radiant one, अमोघदर्शने O one whose sight is unfailing, देवी O goddess, भज look upon, सौम्येन with a gentle, चक्षुषा eye.

40022733.author: Translation
40022733.content: O radiant goddess, giver of boons, you are the mistress of boons and the worlds, and your sight is unfailing; please look upon me with a gentle eye.

40022734.author: पदार्थः
40022734.content: हृद्गतं that which is in the heart, तस्य his, राजर्षेः of the royal sage, विज्ञाय having known, हरसन्निधौ in the presence of Hara, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभं auspicious, वाक्यं words, देवी the goddess, रुद्रस्य of Rudra, संमता approved by.

40022734.author: Translation
40022734.content: Having understood the desire in the heart of that royal sage, the goddess, who was dear to Rudra, replied with auspicious words in the presence of Hara.

40022735.author: पदार्थः
40022735.content: अर्धस्य of half, देवो the god, वरदो is the giver of boons, वरार्धस्य of the other half of the boon, तव to you, हि indeed, अहम् I, तस्मात् therefore, अर्धं half, गृहाण take, त्वं you, स्त्रीपुंसोः of male and female, यावत् as much as, इच्छसि you desire.

40022735.author: Translation
40022735.content: The goddess declared that Shiva grants half of the boons, and she grants the other half, therefore the king should take as much of the male and female aspect as he desires.

40022736.author: पदार्थः
40022736.content: तत् that, अद्भुततरं most wonderful, श्रुत्वा having heard, देव्या from the goddess, वरम् boon, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, सम्प्रहृष्टमना with a greatly delighted mind, भूत्वा having become, राजा the king, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.

40022736.author: Translation
40022736.content: Having heard that most wonderful and unsurpassed boon from the goddess, the king became greatly delighted and then spoke.

40022737.author: पदार्थः
40022737.content: यदि if, देवि O Goddess, प्रसन्ना pleased, मे with me, रूपेण in form/beauty, अप्रतिमा unequalled, भुवि on earth, मासम् for a month, स्त्रीत्वम् womanhood, उपासित्वा having experienced, मासम् for a month, स्याम् may I be, पुरुषः a man, पुनः again.

40022737.author: Translation
40022737.content: O Goddess, if you are pleased with me, who is unequalled in beauty on earth, then may I experience womanhood for one month and then become a man again for another month.

40022738.author: पदार्थः
40022738.content: ईप्सितम् the desired wish, तस्य his, विज्ञाय having understood, देवी the Goddess, सुरुचिरानना with a very beautiful face, प्रत्युवाच replied, शुभम् auspicious, वाक्यम् words, एवमेव exactly so, भविष्यति it shall be.

40022738.author: Translation
40022738.content: Understanding his wish, the Goddess with a very beautiful face replied with auspicious words, saying, 'It shall be exactly so.'

40022739.author: पदार्थः
40022739.content: राजन् O King, पुरुषभूतः having become a man, त्वम् you, स्त्रीभावम् the state of being a woman, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, स्त्रीभूतः having become a woman, च and, परम् next, मासम् month, न not, स्मरिष्यसि will remember, पौरुषम् manhood.

40022739.author: Translation
40022739.content: O King, when you become a man, you will not remember your state as a woman, and when you become a woman for the next month, you will not remember your manhood.

40022740.author: पदार्थः
40022740.content: एवम् thus, सः that, राजा king, पुरुषः a man, मासम् for a month, भूत्वा having been, अथ then, कार्दमिः the son of Kardama, त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी beautiful in the three worlds, नारी a woman, मासम् for a month, एकम् one, इला Ila, अभवत् became.

40022740.author: Translation
40022740.content: Thus, that King Ila, the son of Kardama, having been a man for one month, then became Ila, a woman beautiful in the three worlds, for another month. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्ताशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 87 ।। Thus ends the eighty-seventh sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
